direction.concept: One object in the dark, shown three ways: revealed, examined, and left with its name.
direction.audience: People who buy a watch as an object to keep, and who distrust anything that shouts.
direction.message: The Noctis One is a quiet, precise watch made for the night.
direction.tone: Slow, dark and certain; the film never raises its voice.
direction.palette: Near-black ground, warm off-white ink, and one gold accent taken from the watch’s own indices.
direction.typography: Playfair Display for the lines, small and still; Inter only for the tracked label above them.
direction.motion: One slow camera move per scene on the watch; the copy rises once and then holds.
direction.pacing: Three long scenes of five to six seconds; this is a slow film on purpose, cut only where the idea changes.

scenes.purpose: Reveal the watch from darkness so the object is the first thing understood.
Turn the watch and say the one fact that justifies it: the movement.

text.headline: Seventy hours of quiet precision.
text.subline: A self-winding movement, finished by hand.

scenes.purpose: Close on the name and how to get one, and let the picture go dark.
